ticket.title: Allow birth and death on the same calendar day
ticket.text:
Allow birth and death on the same calendar day

## Impact

The registration form cannot record a patient who died on the same calendar day they were born.

## Affected code

- `packages/esm-patient-registration-app/src/patient-registration/validation/patient-registration-validation.ts`
- `packages/esm-patient-registration-app/src/patient-registration/validation/patient-registration-validation.test.ts`

## Root cause

Death-date validation requires the death date value to be strictly later than the birth date value.

Both dates are represented as date values normalized to midnight. The separately entered death time is not included in this comparison, so the same calendar date is rejected.

## Reproduction

1. Enter a patient’s birth date.
2. Mark the patient as deceased.
3. Enter the same date as the death date.
4. Enter a valid death time.
5. Attempt to submit the form.
6. Validation rejects the death date.

## Expected behavior

Birth and death may occur on the same calendar day. Only a death date on an earlier calendar day should be rejected.

## Implementation direction

Compare the values at calendar-day precision and accept the death date when it is the same as or later than the birth date.

## Acceptance criteria

- The same birth and death date passes validation.
- A death date one day before the birth date fails.
- A later death date passes.
- Future-death-date validation continues to work.
- Add focused tests for each boundary.

Verified against `openmrs-esm-patient-management` commit `c64fb336`.
